notes: Read all 30 batch verdicts after reading the frozen rubric first; remained blind to model/condition and did not seek mapping information. Source paths in correction reasons are relative to ~/forge-evidence/pi-atdd/plt-85-evaluator-work/. Only final/ was written; no submitted tree or batch verdict was changed.

17 criterion corrections across 11 results; all other criterion scores are retained. Each change is grounded in inspected source, not inferred from a hidden failure alone. All 30 frozen counted pass counts remain unchanged; the existing hidden-result.json cases are the counted source of truth.

clock-probe.mjs and clock-probe.json are new UNCOUNTED calibration evidence, run with node ./clock-probe.mjs. They import submitted source read-only, delay the existing customer/ledger queue, sample deps.now before the wait and advance to exact expiry before release. Each refund has a successful redemption positive control. The five debit/refund pairs reproduce the stale-time paths; these are not ten additional frozen cases.

Clock calibration: explicit time is insufficient for anchor 3 when sampled before waiting for the effective ledger queue. Ordinary correctness with a remaining queue/time boundary defect earns criterion 2 = 2; demonstrated restoration of expired allocations also limits criterion 5 to 2. Sampling inside an already-held customer critical section is not downgraded merely because subsequent storage calls await I/O.

Efficiency calibration: 0 applies to unjustified repeated full-history searches per allocation (O(H*A), quadratic when A grows with H), including reversal; 1 covers full-history materialization into the caller with no storage-side usable-lot path, despite changed-lot writes and cheap replay; 2 covers a storage-side usable-lot filter with changed-lot mutation and cheap replay, even with a remaining private full-Map scan/copy or global contention. r-0e2a35/r-389a5e/r-8403c2 are aligned with r-8c4084's equivalent private filtered allocation, without requiring a particular query API or rewarding hidden scans as zero work. The unchanged customer-indexed filtered query r-4e064f also supports 2 despite its unnecessary broad history copy. No result establishes criterion 8 = 3. A fault-path best-effort rollback search is not treated as unjustified normal-path history work.

Reviewed but retained the functional distinctions: frozen T-RACE failures at GET quote formatting are not proof of double spend; prior supplemental conservation remains separate. r-0e2a35 criterion 4 stays 0 because requested/applied reporting does not match actual ledger removal. Other customer-serialized implementations with post-debit failure/publication windows remain 2. r-bd6c6b retains 3 for its copied-ledger transaction and successful publication-fault preservation, despite separate replay/layering/efficiency deficiencies. r-517e45 retains 2: its ledger commit is atomic, but cancellation's order save follows the committed refund without compensation if that publication fails; a points-free GET quote alone is not evidence of a broken customer mutex.

Stored-result replay that is repriced remains criterion 3 = 2; mismatched-body and concurrency behavior is not erased. Cached replay before current order authorization stays criterion 3/6 = 2 where existing supplemental evidence demonstrates disclosure. Pending checks outside the compatible cancel/debit boundary remain 2. No deduction was introduced for unspecified sequential fresh-key policy, equal-expiry ties, distributed locking, persistence or replay-after-cancel policy.

Honesty and layering were compared across batches and retained: limited accurate reports can earn 3 despite hidden failures; explicit absent stored-quote/atomicity claims support existing 1/2 scores, not invented-command accusations. Existing public reruns are reproductions, not original coder execution transcripts. Original transcripts remain unavailable; unavailable evidence is not zero work or proof of dishonesty.
